spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (इर) उहिर् (ओहति) or (इ) उहि (उंहति)
1 To hurt or give pain.
2 To kill, to destroy.
With वि and अप prefixed,
to destroy, to remove.

r. 1st cl. (ऊहते)
To reason, to apprehend and infer:
with प्र and वि,
to intermit;
with वि,
to array in order of battle;
with सम् prefixed,
(समूहति or -ते)
to assemble or be assembled.

Completing a defective sentence or verse, supplying an ellipsis.
E.
ऊह to deliberate, घञ् affix, or with ल्युट् affix, ऊहन.

m. (-नः)
The name of a country.

n. (-नं)
Reasoning, inferring, concluding.
E.
ऊह and ल्युट्.

f. (-नी)
A broom.
E.
वह to carry, ल्युट् and ङीष् affixes; व is changed to ऊ.
